correctness.rationale: For every safe prime at least 11, cyclic order 2q and quadratic reciprocity give the exact primitive-root criterion, with the unique order-2 exception -1. The 7 mod8 explicit construction verifies three nonresidues and product congruent to b. The 3 mod8 character-pair count follows from the fully proved quadratic Jacobi sum and linear sums; b=p-3 is the only forbidden counted residue; the fourth root cannot equal -1 due nonsquareness of 1/2. Direct checking handles p=5 and p=7. The verifier checks all 389 safe primes up to 50000 but is not used to infer the unbounded result.

originality.rationale: Sun explicitly poses the four-primitive-root assertion as Conjecture 4.2(i), dated 2015-08-05. An exact safe-prime classification and a uniform fixed-2 count were not among the inspected primary results, database entries or semantically similar published-result hits. Two-primitive-root additive representation does not imply that their sum and triple product are primitive. Originality is qualified by a possible unlocated equivalent specialization; the elementary Legendre character identities are not claimed as new.
